409 Conflict plus later exact readback provides a viable repository-local conflict/recovery signal; per-window rate limits can be handled across invocations without a monthly/trial/paid quota dependency.
verification_result.material_correction: The GitHub Contents API sha guard is a compare against the blob SHA of the target file, not against the entire repository branch HEAD commit. Therefore the reasoning architecture is supported only when 'canonical HEAD' means the designated mutable head file and 'exact predecessor HEAD identity' means that file's exact predecessor blob/content identity. It is not source-verified as a CAS on the Git branch HEAD or as a transaction over unrelated repository paths. The Git-reference update endpoint also lacks an expected-old-ref SHA argument, so it does not independently supply strict branch-ref CAS semantics on this surface.
verification_result.lost_ack_scope: Primary-source semantics are compatible with the proposed lost-ack recovery pattern for repository-visible effects: after an uncertain update, the next invocation can read the canonical head file and exact candidate identity. Distinguishing 'landed then later advanced' requires the immutable committed chain to preserve the candidate, not merely the current tip.
verification_result.external_effect_boundary: No primary source turns an arbitrary external side effect into a transactionally conditional consequence of the repository CAS. The architecture remains unresolved outside repository-visible effects.
